messages:
maria: quick Q — I'm trying to triage a spike for ACME's gen route in eu-west. Where's the saved log query that filters by org/model/route/region/status?
chen: there's one we use for 5xx heatmaps. try the logs console link first: https://console.redwood.ai/logs?view=acme_eu_errors
samir: if you want to run a quick filter in the query bar, this usually works:```service:inference AND org_id:acme AND model:/rwkv-13B.*/ AND route:generate AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:[500 TO 599]```
chen: ^ that is the same as the saved view but with regex on model. you can also swap status for latency_ms:>1000 for slow requests.
maria: awesome — thanks. where are saved searches stored? want to add a more specific one for canary models.
olivia: saved searches are under Observability -> Views -> Saved searches. we name them like `org/acme | region/eu | route/generate | status/5xx` so they sort together.
olivia: if you want to create one programmatically you can POST to our internal API (only for infra team):```curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/saved_views -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"acme-eu-gen-5xx","query":"service:inference AND org_id:acme AND route:generate AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:[500 TO 599]","tags":["acme","eu","gen","alerts"]}'```
maria: perfect, I'll create `acme-eu-gen-5xx` now. also, Olivia — can you check alert thresholds? current page-flip alert fired at 100 errors/min but this traffic pattern is concerning more for error rate per model.
olivia: yeah, we should tune to a percent-based alert: errors/requests > 1% over 5m for any model in prod. I'll open a PR for the alert rule change.
samir: ping @olivia when you open the PR, I'll review. small note: include `model.keyword` in the grouping to avoid regex explosion.
olivia: noted. planning to add a saved view + alert rule + dashboard tile. will put links in the PR.
infra-bot: Saved search `acme-eu-gen-5xx` created by maria at 1771234582 :sparkles:
maria: done — created and pinned to the org's dashboard. link: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/views/acme-eu-gen-5xx
chen: nice, can you also export the query so SRE runbook has it? small snippet for runbook:
```query: service:inference AND org_id:acme AND model:/rwkv-13B.*/ AND route:generate AND region:eu-west-1 AND status:[500 TO 599]
view: acme-eu-gen-5xx (console link)
alert: errors/requests > 1% over 5m (group by model.keyword)```
maria: adding to runbook now. thanks all :thumbsup:
samir: quick follow-up — there's intermittent 429s upstream that look like throttle for a specific model variant. if it shows up in the same saved view, tag it as `throttle` and we'll route to the Dedicated pool.
maria: will do. good catch.
olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/412 — description includes saved view, alert rule, dashboard tile. reviewers: @samir, @chen.
samir: reviewing this afternoon.
maria: closing the loop here, feel free to add more filters to the saved view if you need narrower slices (by deploy_sha, canary:true, or client_app).
chen: thanks — moving this to done in the board.
